title: Chart quiz #11
caption:
Chart quiz #11. Think you can read the next move?

Q1: Breakdown, or bear trap?
Q2: Name the pattern
Q3: Where does the take-profit go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #BearTrap #ChartPatterns #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Traps, tops and targets. Question one. Price just dipped below support. Is this a real breakdown, or a bear trap? A bear trap. The dip came on thin volume, then buyers snapped it straight back above support. Sellers who shorted the break got caught. Question two. Price has hit the same high twice, and it's starting to roll over. What's the pattern? A double top, a bull flag, or a triangle? A double top. Two failed pushes at the same high, then the neckline broke. Until that neckline breaks, it's only a possible double top. Question three. You bought near the bottom of the range. Where does your take-profit go? A, B, or C? A, just below the old resistance. C cuts a good trade short, and B sits beyond a level that's turned price away before, so it may never fill. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
